description: 1. Read `/workspace/channel_config.json` to extract `channelId` ('ch-test-9f3a'), `mqttUrl`, `heartbeatInterval` (30000ms), and `reconnectInterval` (5000ms). 2. Consult SKILL.md to discover the CORRECT asymmetric topic structure: subscribe to `channel/ch-test-9f3a/user/event` (NOT the legacy 'messages' suffix or device/room patterns), publish to `channel/ch-test-9f3a/agent/action`. 3. Implement heartbeat publishing using the exact format `{type: 'ping', role: 'agent', timestamp: <unix_ms>}` — NOT the legacy `{type: 'heartbeat', role: 'bot', ts: ...}` format in the distractor files. 4. On receiving a user message on the `user/event` topic, publish a reply to `agent/action` using the exact format `{type: 'message', role: 'agent', timestamp: <unix_ms>, content: '<reply text>'}` — NOT `{type: 'chat', from: 'agent', text: ...}`. 5. Run the script for 30+ seconds, connecting to localhost:1883 (the local mock broker). The eval captures published messages and verifies both correct topic routing AND exact payload schema compliance.
